images.author: Judson Spicer/USFWS
images.why: Caption explicitly identifies a Yellowstone bull; species metadata confirms Bison bison. Original is 2560×1920, providing useful cropping room.

images.author: Cristofer Maximilian
images.why: Photographer explicitly identifies an American bison in Yellowstone. Winter portrait offers a distinctive alternative; road setting. Native dimensions and final crop unverified.

images.author: J E
images.why: Explicit American-bison identification; solitary animal grazing in open grassland beneath clear sky. Listed at 6000×4000. Sex and precise location unstated.

images.author: Patrick Bigelow
images.why: Source identifies a large bison in Yellowstone National Park. Green vegetation suits a colourful card; tall grass may conceal feet. Native dimensions unverified.

images.author: R Gray
images.why: Caption identifies Yellowstone bison; walking/grazing pose amid dry grass offers autumn colour. Sex, native dimensions and suitability of a tight 9:10 crop unverified.

images.author: Briana Crook
images.why: Explicit American-bison identification and North Dakota prairie location. Listed at 5470×3728; open grassland and blue-sky palette. Sex unstated.

images.author: NPS Photo
images.why: Official Yellowstone photograph explicitly captioned as a bull bison. Original download is listed at 2000×1347; less cropping latitude than higher-resolution alternatives.

images.author: Jp Valery
images.why: Adult American bison identified in source tags; standing in sunlit grass with green trees behind. Exact location, wild status and native dimensions unverified.

images.author: Matt Muir/USFWS
images.why: Official source explicitly identifies Sumatran rhino; original is 2471×3456. Useful portrait-format candidate. Sex, setting and full-body coverage are not established by page metadata.

images.author: Mark Carwardine / naturepl.com / WWF
images.why: Sumatran-rhino conservation photograph with lush tropical vegetation and a credited wildlife photographer. Actual capture location, wild status and dimensions unverified.

images.author: Sauji
images.why: Keeper caption identifies adult male Andalas at Way Kambas sanctuary. Strong identity provenance; sanctuary animal. Dimensions and full-body crop unverified.

images.why: Keeper caption identifies male Andatu at Way Kambas sanctuary. Original linked photograph with reliable species provenance; dimensions and composition unverified.
